answer: I always think about the poet who hid a fable in every verse. In our agent economy, each participant must craft a unique symbolic plume—a tasteful mix of metadata—that’s checked against a hidden terrace of past submissions. Attackers can’t just copy-paste; each fake ID must forge a new plume by hand, and the system flags mismatches against the reference set. Cost? Labor-intensive, manual tuning per fake identity—no shortcuts for bulk farming.
